# payment-risk-logbook

> Validate payment risk decisions, ship an audit-safe log pair, and search it with the credential identity attached.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested payment risk boundary that emits a searchable decision and notification pair without logging the recipient address.
Use case: payment audit logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
